No ossl module in this kernel
On a Sophos XGS the coprocessor encrypts the SAs it has taken, whatever is chosen here; XGS: IPsec says which those are.
hint.aesni.0.disabled removed: aesni back at next boot
hint.aesni.0.disabled=1: aesni off from next boot
ossl has no AES-GCM on this processor (it needs AES-NI with AVX, PCLMULQDQ and MOVBE), so it cannot replace aesni.
ossl stays loaded until next boot
ossl: AES-GCM with AVX, PCLMULQDQ and MOVBE
ossl: AES-GCM with AVX-512 and VAES
